# Superbloom House

> Superbloom House is a creative agency that helps brands make work people
> actually want to watch, share, and talk about — one integrated model
> spanning brand, content, and production, powered by a 300+ member Creative
> Collective.

## Site map

- [Home](https://www.superbloomhouse.com/): Featured work, capabilities, news, and contact.
- [Work](https://www.superbloomhouse.com/work): Case studies and selected client work.
- [Who We Are](https://www.superbloomhouse.com/who-we-are): The agency, the Collective, and how the model works.
- [Index](https://www.superbloomhouse.com/index): Press, news, and announcements.
- [Zine](https://www.superbloomhouse.com/zine): Superbloom's publication — issues and articles.
- [Shop](https://www.superbloomhouse.com/shop): Prints and objects from Superbloom artists.

## Notes for agents

- All pages are server-rendered HTML; no client API is required to read
  content. Video streams via Mux (HLS); poster images are available at
  `https://image.mux.com/{playbackId}/thumbnail.webp`.
- Contact: the site has no contact email on-page; use the inquiry form in the
  contact section of any page (anchored at `#contact`).
